about_the_game:
🛡 StuffTD — Tower Defense Demo

StuffTD is a retro-futuristic tower defense game focused on tactical decisions, smart economy management, and a unique upgrade system. Choose your strategy, combine turrets, enhance them with items, and survive waves of enemies that grow stronger every minute.

⚔ What’s in the Demo

  • 12 turret factions with distinct playstyles: from auto-attackers and debuffers to summoners.

  • Unique abilities for each turret: slows, AoE damage, drone summons, chaining enemies, and more.

  • Item and upgrade system — socket artifacts into turrets, level them up, and unlock new synergies.

  • Tactical economy — decide whether to buy a new turret, upgrade an existing one, or invest in extra slots.

  • Intense solo mode — designed for one player only: no multiplayer, just you against endless waves.

🌌 Why Play the Demo

  • Retro-futuristic atmosphere with stylish pixel art.

  • A chance to experience the core mechanics and balance before full release.

  • Every decision matters: a wrong upgrade or placement can cost you the match.

🚀 Wishlist Now

This is just the beginning — the full version will feature new factions, bosses every few waves, and expanded build options.
Add the game to your wishlist to stay updated and support development!

short_description: Build wild multi-class turrets, stack abilities, and outsmart waves of enemies in this fast-paced, cartoon-style sci-fi tower defense! Combine synergies, manipulate cooldowns, and unleash chaos with explosive effects and clever combos.
